name: Luvre – WordPress Media Library Folders
author: GhozyLab

sections.description:
Luvre is a powerful and user-friendly WordPress plugin that helps you efficiently manage your media library images, posts, pages, and custom post types by organizing them into folders. Whether you’re a blogger, designer, or developer, Luvre makes content management easier and more intuitive.

Best WordPress media library folders plugin
🚀 LIVE DEMO | 📚 Documentation | 🌐 Website

⚡️ Key Features

  • Drag & Drop to organize files effortlessly – Move media files between folders with a simple drag-and-drop interface.
  • Bulk operations for faster media management – Perform actions on multiple files at once to save time.
  • Backup and Restore – Easily safeguard your folder structure with our Backup & Restore feature.
  • Custom user roles and folder permissions – Define who can access, create, or manage folders.
  • Create galleries using a WordPress block – Instantly generate galleries or sliders directly from selected folders using a dedicated block.
  • API for developers – REST APIs enable external plugins or applications to interact with your site programmatically — including actions like retrieving folder structures, creating new folders, assigning items to folders, and much more.

Upgrade to the PRO version for advanced features and enhanced customization options.

🔥 PRO FEATURES

  • Nested folders – Organize your files with unlimited folder levels to mimic traditional file structures.
  • Organize media files, pages, posts, and custom post types into folders – Go beyond media by managing all your content types with folders.
  • Customize folder styles with custom colors and other options – Visually distinguish folders with color coding and styling preferences.
  • Advanced filtering options – Filter files by type, size, date, or folder for quick access.
  • More customization options for folders and styles – Fine-tune folder appearance to match your branding or theme.
  • Create galleries, sliders, or carousels using a WordPress block – Showcase folder contents in beautiful visual layouts.
  • Use keyboard shortcuts to navigate faster – Work quickly with built-in keyboard shortcuts for power users.
  • Integration with popular page builders – Fully compatible with:
    — Gutenberg
    — Elementor
    — WPBakery
    — WP Composer
    — Visual Composer
    — Themify
    — Divi Builder by Elegant Themes
    — Thrive Architect
    — Beaver Builder
    — Oxygen
    — Cornerstone Page Builder
    — Tatsu Builder
    — Bricks
    — Brizy WordPress Builder
    — Fusion Page Builder
    — Zion Builder
    — And many more!
  • Download folders as ZIP files – Export entire folders quickly in ZIP format for easy sharing or backups.
  • Premium support and regular updates – Access expert help and regular feature updates with the PRO version.

😻 WHY USE LUVRE?

The default WordPress media library can quickly become overwhelming, with thousands of files sorted only by year and month. Finding a specific image used in a post or page can be time-consuming.

Luvre solves this by letting you organize your media into custom folders using a simple drag-and-drop interface. Whether you’re managing existing files or uploading new ones, Luvre helps keep your library clean, structured, and easy to navigate.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for Luvre.
  4. Click Install Now, then activate the plugin.

Manual Installation (via WordPress Admin):

  1. Download the latest version of the plugin (Luvre.x.x.x.zip).
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel and go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin, select the ZIP file, and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin once the installation is complete.

Manual Installation (via FTP):

  1. Download and extract the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload the luvre folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  4. Navigate to Plugins, find Luvre, and activate it.

For Mac Users:
* If your downloaded plugin is a folder, right-click and select Compress to create a .zip file before uploading.
sections.faq:
Can I use Luvre with any WordPress theme?

Yes! Luvre is compatible with all well-coded WordPress themes.

Is Luvre beginner-friendly?

Absolutely! The intuitive interface makes it easy for beginners to organize their media library, posts, pages, and custom post types.

Can I use Luvre with posts and custom post types?

Yes! You can enable Luvre for specific post types in the settings.

How do I upgrade to Luvre Pro?

You can upgrade to Luvre Pro from our official website for additional features and premium support.

How can I support the plugin?

You can support us by recommending Luvre to your friends, leaving a positive review, or upgrading to the Pro version!
